Mini Zombies have arrived and it’s time to PARTY !!!

These party guests have gotten out of control, I guess it’s either time to join them or fight them. Share a screenshot of you playing the new Zombie Within Gate Mode!

In this mode Defenders now have to fight off mini zombies whenever a Zombie Imposter breaks a generator. These bite-sized enemies will actively chase the nearby Defender, but to give them a leg up, Defenders will have various powers ups scattered throughout the map. They can also find power ups in chests and drops after slaying some mini zombies. Use #GateMode in your submission to qualify. 

Our favorite screenshot will win 3 Zombie Within Keys for their friends!

 Submit a screenshot to the Zombie Within Steam Forum of you playing the new Gate Mode

Zombie Within is officially 1.0!

WEST HUNT DLC
Who doesn’t love Cowboys vs. Zombies? To combine our two games the developers have created some epic crossover from their wildly successful Western social deduction game West Hunt and Zombie Within!

NEW GAME MODE: Gate Mode
In this mode Defenders now have to fight off mini zombies whenever a Zombie Imposter breaks a generator. These bite-sized enemies will actively chase the nearby Defender, but to give them a leg up, Defenders will have various powers ups scattered throughout the map. They can also find power ups in chests and drops after slaying some mini zombies.

Thank You
We want to thank everyone again for being here. We hope that you enjoy our new game mode and DLC, the journey to 1.0 has been one we will never forget!

notes.title: Community Event: Summertime Tall Tales
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/88c6e4caffcdb48ad7827b4856f8d11274bf2999.jpg

Hello Happy Campers! 

Here we are gathered around the campfire, time to tell the Zombie Within Community tall tales about your greatest kills in the game! Tell us the tale of how you’re the best Zombie or Defender around with an accompanying picture of your in-game stats, and our favorite retelling will win 3 Zombie Within Keys to give away to their friends! Use #SummertimeTallTales in your submissions to be considered.

Example:
There I was hiding behind the rvs in the main map, when my buddy Chris rounded the bend as a massive hulking zombie. He was swinging at innocent townsfolk left and right, but that’s when I unleashed hell on this overzealous powerhouse. With my makeshift rifle I slid out from behind the rv’s and in one shot, completely downed the hulking monstrosity. Right between the eyes, before he even knew what hit him. I had been waiting all night to settle our score from 5 matches before when he did me dirty with a trap in front of the ambulances. Revenge never felt so good as I watched his massive form crumple in front of me. The town was safe… for now. #SummertimeTallTales

Submission Rules:

 Share a screenshot of your best stats with an accompanying “tall tale” of how you achieved those stats to the Screenshot section of the Steam Forum
 Use #SummetimeTallTales in your submission to be considered
 One entry per user
 Once winners have been announced, you have 30 days to respond to the ww_cm account to receive your keys

 Open the Steam client and click on "View" and then "Screenshots" at the top to access the screenshot uploader.

If you need more assistance with how to upload a screenshot to Steam Community, please check here https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=181142704 

Rewards:

 1 Winner will win 3 Zombie Within Keys to give away to their friends

notes.title: 1st Patch Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/6ae5eb26951233fbcd34b1ab3c2397a80ae55353.png

Hello Zombies and Survivors

Here is our first round of patch notes since releasing into early access! We appreciate all the feedback we have received since launch and want to encourage our growing community to keep it coming! That's what early access is all about, you sharing your thoughts and suggestions with us so we can make the best possible game come 1.0 ~ Speaking of suggestions, feel free to join the Wandering Wizard Discord or post to Steam forums with your feedback. 

We have made these patches and hotfixes incrementally since early access launch, so if you do not see these changes to your game, please check if there is an update queued. 

Patch Notes
Gameplay

 Fixed issue where a lobby could have 2 Engineers in a 2v1 queue
 Fixed an issue where the AI could get caught on a light post in the map
 Added an indicator of the number of shots needed in the Engineer tutorial when they shoot the Imposter
 Added indicative arrows to the Imposter tutorial

UI

 The “Manual” button in the main menu no longer permanently glows
 The tutorial now informs the player of the first role they are learning about
 Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in a loop while attempting to join the Discord
 Fixed an issue where “Custom Mode” would overrun the textbox in German, Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese
 New VFX now appears on the minimap when a trap explodes, a scan discovers an imposter, or when an imposter kills an innocent
 The in-game Shop now has prices listed for each item
 Players should no longer get stuck in a loop if they press H and then J and refuse to join the Discord

Functionality

 The game now correctly enters “Full Screen’ when selecting “Revert to default settings”
 Fixed issues where “Play” button would not work sometimes
 Fixed issues where skins would not equip
Fixed an issue where some Steam achievements were not working
Fixed an issue where an Imposter could win if an innocent died after the Imposter was killed

Text

 Fixed text overlapping the tutorial video occurring under the “Saving Innocents” section of the manual in French, German & Portuguese.
 Fixed “Manual” text overlapping the “Settings” text when game language is set to Japanese
 Fixed “Tutorial” and “Custom Mode” buttons having their text go outside the box when highlighted in Japanese
 Made several grammar and punctuation edits to text in the Manual
 Added parentheses to “Break” and “Fix” prompts for clarity
 Fixed tutorial text not displaying properly in Turkish

Audio

 Generator breaking and fixed sounds can no longer be heard when audio sliders are set to 0
 Ambient radio broadcast audio can no longer be heard when all audio is set to 0
 Fixed issues with zombie SFX not playing when transforming


We’re excited to share this game with everyone! Remember to join the Wandering Wizard Discord server to chat about the game, provide feedback, find people to play with, and more!

- The Zombie Within Community Team

notes.title: Zombie Within is Available Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/f77d5f87d5fd72b10355521212889071f9b594f5.jpg

Zombie Within Available Now

Zombie Within is Wandering Wizard and New Gen Studios latest collaboration, which is now officially released in early access! We are so excited to share this Zombie Apocalypse themed Social Deduction Game with you.

Zombie Within is set in a post-apocalyptic camp where Defenders are tasked with saving humanity by stopping the spread of a zombie virus killing innocent people. But among the defenders, undercover Zombie Imposters are determined to spread a devastating virus, aiming to eradicate humanity. Play with up to 6 friends or play single player and test your mettle against the game itself!

Play as a Defender
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/948acbc0c30bc656378bf5fd1be5bcbd43bb26f0.png

Play as a Zombie
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/bf16216990ae24ee033223aa8fce474c6abf02ae.png

KEY FEATURES:

 Asymmetrical Social Deduction: Play as either a Zombie Imposter, blending in to kill as many civilians as possible in the camp, or a Defender, attempting to figure out who amongst the civilians is secretly a zombie.
 Cause Mayhem as the Zombie Imposter:As a Zombie Imposter, pretend you are one of the many civilians of the camp and break as many generators as possible to spread the infection. Once enough infection has spread, an Imposter can transform into a monstrous zombie form, which allows them to attack civilians directly.
 Protect the camp as a Defender: Defenders can take on the roles of Hunters or Engineers. Hunters take down zombie imposters easily and can lay down traps to expose them. Meanwhile, Engineers have tools that allow them to quickly find broken generators, and reveal the imposter amongst the civilians.
 Randomly Generated Maps: Play on either the default map, or test your skills in a randomly generated camp map, with different layouts and generator spawns.


Leaderboard Event: Undead Rush
Be sure to also check out our Leaderboard event as well! We wanted to kick off our release with a very special leaderboard event for you! We’re welcoming this new community with open arms, and a scanner at the ready. 

The Top 3 Leaderboard winners will win 3 Zombie Within keys for them and their friends. Be sure to read the official announcement below for more information! https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1894460/view/4166462894410243823

Join the Discord
Join the Wandering Wizard Discord to find games, chat about gameplay, and share your feedback with the devs! Join Here.

Stream
On top of getting in on the action yourself you can always check out Twitch and YouTube for gameplay! PENTA will be hopping on with his friends (Kyle, TheChief1114, Moosebrother, s0upes, and CurvyLlama) around 3pm PST today to feature the game, find his Twitch here: https://www.twitch.tv/penta


Sale
Zombie Within will be discounted at 20% for an entire week! Swipe it now and save!


There's been a lot of anticipation up until this point and we’re so excited that the day of release is finally here! And we can’t wait to see all of the fun gameplay that’s going to come out as our community grows!

notes.title: Community Leaderboard Event: Undead Rush
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43698164/de07e3d04721cd1f2f6e8ba490d62e9a16ff9d87.jpg

Undead Rush

Hello Zombies and Survivors, we wanted to kick off our release with a very special leaderboard event for you! We’re welcoming this new community with open arms, and a scanner at the ready. 

The Top 3 Leaderboard winners will win 3 Zombie Within keys for them and their friends. Be sure to read below for more information!

Submission Rules:

 Participants must be a member of the Wandering Wizard Discord to Qualify. Join here.
 Winners will be announced via Discord. Once Leaderboard winners have been announced, they have 24 hours to submit the following via Mod Mail; A screenshot of their Zombie Within Username and a link to their Steam Profile. 
 No cheating or bug abusing is allowed. Please be aware that rules may be added/changed during the event.

Rewards:

 The Top 3 Leaderboard winners will win 3 Zombie Within Steam keys each for them and their friends


We will cut off the leaderboard event at 10:00am PST on March 1st. Winners will be announced via the Wandering Wizard Discord on that day.

Super excited to see who tops the charts! Survive or Spread the Infection, no matter what side you play, stay Sus. 

- The Zombie Within Community Team
